observations: Brand 'MANTY' is visible on the down tube in photo 0.
The bike is parked outdoors on a tiled surface.
The photo appears to be a stock or generic listing image rather than a photo of a specific unit in a local environment.
No photo shows the drivetrain components (gears, chain, cassette) or the brake levers clearly enough to verify condition.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the MANTY brand name on the frame.
The photo does not show the rear derailleur or the gear cassette clearly enough to confirm the number of gears.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The drivetrain may be non-functional or have excessive wear.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled through all gear ranges.

risks.risk: The brakes may be worn or the pads may be missing.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the brake levers and the brake pads.

risks.risk: The bike may have structural damage or cracks in the frame.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the frame rails and the seat tube.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the rear wheel showing the gear cassette and the rear derailleur.
Photo of the front wheel showing the front derailleur.
Video of the bike being ridden or pedaled to demonstrate gear and brake function.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
